gap_candidates.description: Multi-account behavior exists in slices (provider/auth panels) but is not threaded through repo/project/worktree execution contracts — account identity must be end-to-end in all execution contracts | PM-owned SCM state is not fully visible: managed template repos, active git operations, live-run artifact roots, and worktree recovery state need Orchestrator/SCM registration | Package-based lane pools are still missing as a canonical concept in SCM docs — WorktreeGitImprovement.md and GitHub_Integration.md must define this | Worktree visibility is only partially wired between Source Control and Orchestrator — the interface contract between these two surfaces must be fully defined
exact_missing_items: Multi-account behavior exists in slices (provider/auth panels) but is not threaded through repo/project/worktree execution contracts — account identity must be end-to-end in all execution contracts
